config.intervention: Start both arms from the identical existing SRC490 36-phone validation-selected Transformer. Reset AdamW and dropout RNG identically. Fine-tune BCE+KL versus BCE+KL+softEER only; freeze the encoder, all inputs and all 36 phones.
config.pairs: Replay source schedule rows 56000:64000, grouping four consecutive rows into each 128-query/256-trial batch. Preserve every positive/negative pair and its common availability mask. This is a matched fine-tuning experiment, not an exact continuation of the old optimizer or a from-scratch comparison.
config.surrogate: Sigmoid-smoothed FAR and FRR on raw weighted similarity scores, with their unique equal-error threshold solved by bisection in float64 and differentiated implicitly. Pool the training batch across corpora. Fixed temperature 0.03 and coefficient 1; no parameter search or test-driven revisions. This is not a reproduction of the published EERLoss algorithm.
config.selection: Evaluate real validation EER every 250 updates including zero. Select the earliest minimum equal-corpus mean across JVS/CV/JTube. Report selected and fixed-final models for both arms, plus the unchanged starting model. Freeze all models and validation FAR1% thresholds before any new test inference.
config.limits: Three acoustic seeds, one fine-tuning RNG seed. Previously observed test speakers; no independent new population. EER uses scorable trials; FAR/FRR include unscorable trials as rejections. No standard-model replacement. A single temperature/coefficient/budget cannot establish the best achievable EER-oriented training. Pooled batch softEER is only a surrogate for corpus-wise full-dataset EER.

bootstrap.method: Paired query/claim speaker bootstrap, shared draws across seeds and variants, independent corpora. Conditional on fixed models; excludes training/selection uncertainty.
